relations.subject: William Charles Hollings
relations.evidence: Cadet of E.I.C. 1826 and left for Calcutta. Learned quickly Hindustani and soon became an Interpreter. Served in different parts of northern India, finally in Cawnpore (Kanpur). Rised to Captain, but in 1850 was dismissed
